pending.meaning: Count all pending FIFO payload identities after the event.
pending.alignment_value_transform: identity only between native and anchor-shifted displays; source-to-state simulation and state-to-count derivations above are not identity transforms

completed.meaning: Count all completed payload identities after the event; these frozen cases contain only required jobs.
completed.alignment_value_transform: identity only between native and anchor-shifted displays; source-to-state simulation and state-to-count derivations above are not identity transforms

outstanding.formula: len([id for id in identities.required if id not in identities.completed])
outstanding.meaning: Count required payload identities not yet completed.
outstanding.alignment_value_transform: identity only between native and anchor-shifted displays; source-to-state simulation and state-to-count derivations above are not identity transforms

absent.meaning: Count required payload identities with no listed pending, completed, or backup copy.
absent.alignment_value_transform: identity only between native and anchor-shifted displays; source-to-state simulation and state-to-count derivations above are not identity transforms

rate.formula: initial declared world rate before action; selected jobs_per_tick for set_service_rate after action; otherwise initial world rate
rate.meaning: Configured service capacity. A pause can prevent service while this value stays positive.
rate.alignment_value_transform: identity only between native and anchor-shifted displays; source-to-state simulation and state-to-count derivations above are not identity transforms

backups.meaning: Count available backup payload identities; replay copies payloads and does not consume the backups.
backups.alignment_value_transform: identity only between native and anchor-shifted displays; source-to-state simulation and state-to-count derivations above are not identity transforms

required.meaning: Count identities in the stated required task.
required.alignment_value_transform: identity only between native and anchor-shifted displays; source-to-state simulation and state-to-count derivations above are not identity transforms

service_offered.formula: values.rate if event_kind == service_end and tick > action.parameters.pause_ticks(default 0), else 0
service_offered.meaning: Capacity slots offered at this service-end event, not jobs actually completed. No slots are offered at pre/post action records.
service_offered.alignment_value_transform: identity only between native and anchor-shifted displays; source-to-state simulation and state-to-count derivations above are not identity transforms
